h1: WooCommerce plugin code audit and fix list
overview: We read your plugin the way a careful reviewer would. We run the WordPress coding standards checks, look for missing escaping, nonces and capability checks, test database queries and hooks for speed and confirm compatibility with current WooCommerce, HPOS and PHP. You get a written report with each finding ranked by effort and impact, so your team can fix what matters first.

faq: Do you change my plugin during the audit?
No. The audit reads and reports only. The Premium package includes up to three sample fixes, which arrive as a separate pull request that you can accept or ignore.
What do you need from me?
A zip or repository access, and the WooCommerce and PHP versions you aim to support. A short note on your biggest worry, such as a slow admin page, helps us aim the review.
Does the audit include a security review?

It covers the common weaknesses, such as missing escaping, nonces, capability checks and unsafe queries. It is a code review, not a full penetration test, and the report says what it did and did not cover.
Can you fix the findings afterwards?
Yes. We can quote the fixes separately, or you can hand the report to your own team. It is written so another developer can act on each finding without needing us.
